blockingIssues.description: Month-header detection in extract.py uses prefix matching and mislabels non-month columns (e.g., 'Marketable securities') with month annotations.
Fast-path logic is all-or-nothing; unresolved data requests force full LLM fallback instead of partial per-request fallback as required.
CY row filtering is keyed to granularity='monthly_all' rather than explicit calendar-year targeting, causing over-filtering risk on non-CY monthly requests.
Required extraction oracle eval at n=50 was not completed/reported; baseline_metrics.json still records oracle_extraction.n=20.

appliedUpdates.description: Added additive command `oracle_extract_n50: uv run python extract.py --test-oracle --n 50` to align shared command surface with VAL-EXTR-007 validation sample size.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Update pipeline-worker validator guidance to align with mission AGENTS scoped-validation policy by default (run validators on changed files unless mission explicitly requires full-repo checks).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Multiple extraction reviews flagged repeated mismatch: SKILL.md Step 4 requires repo-wide `ruff check .`/`pyright`, while AGENTS requires scoped checks due known unrelated failures.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Make pipeline-worker TDD red-phase requirement conditional for lint/typecheck-only cleanup tasks (allow direct fix + regression validation without forced failing-test stage).
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Reviews for deterministic-fast-path and lint-typecheck-cleanup noted skill-procedure friction where TDD-first did not fit lint/type-focused scope.

suggestedGuidanceUpdates.suggestion: Add explicit policy for pre-commit failures caused by unrelated/pre-existing findings: when to retry, when to isolate changed files, and when (if ever) `--no-verify` is acceptable.
suggestedGuidanceUpdates.evidence: Three extraction reviews observed commit-flow churn around unrelated pre-commit findings and inconsistent worker handling.
